notes: Supply: banks leave their old guild before migrating, and gather on the nearest free squares around the customer instead of a fixed 24-square ring. A basket that ends short now cancels the game's own send before the rest goes to another bank, so stock is no longer sent twice and left uncounted. A stock reading too low for the basket no longer sends. Supply tab: order any amount per resource, in billions, and retry a retired bank from its order card. The Linux-only fleet manifest and account limit are no longer in the Windows build.
